Complete the online application form for the desired Assistant Professor or Librarian post.
Ensure all required academic qualifications and personal details are correctly filled in accordance with UGC, Punjab Govt, Panjab University, and NCTE standards.

content_sections.text: Surjeet Memorial College of Education has advertised a total of 19 vacancies for the B.Ed course across various subjects and disciplines. The post-wise distribution is as follows:

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The selected candidates for the posts of Assistant Professor and Librarian will be appointed on a regular basis. The pay scale and emoluments will be governed by the rules and norms established by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Punjab Government, Panjab University, Chandigarh, and NCTE.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are available in SMCE Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 19 vacancies have been announced for Assistant Professor and Librarian posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SMCE Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply within 30 days from the publication of the advertisement, with the application window closing on 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Where should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications online through the official portal at https://facultyjobs.puchd.ac.in.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligible subjects for Assistant Professor vacancies?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available in Perspective in Education, Pedagogy of Punjabi, Hindi, English, Social Studies, Political Science, History, Home Science, Science, Life Science, Computer Science, Commerce, Economics, Fine Arts, Health and Physical Education, Performing Arts, and Librarian.

faq.question: Q5. What qualifications are required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess qualifications and conditions laid down by the U.G.C., Punjab Govt., Panjab University, Chandigarh, and NCTE.

faq.question: Q6. Are reservations applicable for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, reservation for S.C./S.T. candidates and persons with disabilities is applicable as per the rules of P.U., Punjab Government, or Government of India.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee specified in the notification?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.
